name: Kurisu Mai
source:
A lovely, delicate girl who was the protagonist’s classmate. Though they barely spoken to each other in the past, their relationship grew much closer after they reunited following graduation.

Although she is a girl, for some reason she is undergoing treatment at the Virginity department.

This delicate girl, as fragile as a piece of glass, is hiding a secret she couldn’t tell anyone. Entrusting herself to the one to whom she would reveal that secret, the girl’s pale skin flushed with heat.

[From [url=http://www.milkcrown.co.jp/hakudaku/dotei/dt_mai.html]official site[/url]]
